_comment: WO-3, repair the fast trainer (Next-Phase Build Brief 2026-10-05; ADR 0020 amendment
2026-10-05, D4). Every WO-3 pilot is the all-positions cell PR #183 measured
(all-positions-pilot-6pct.json: v1's shape, BCE, 32 negatives, batch 512, seed 42) on
O-25's 6% partition, with at most one thing changed. The protocol hash below must be
confirmed on the run before any number is read. Stop rule: at most 8 pilots and one
full run in WO-3; a check that fails twice, or a result that contradicts its
expectation, stops the thread for the owner.
Revised plan (owner, 2026-10-07), item (b): the all-positions trainer on cell 0b's
exact settings (sampled softmax, 1,024 negatives, early stopping as WO-4 built it: 3
to 5 passes, probe = last training target of a seeded 1% of users), seed 42, O-25 6%
partition. Compared with the strict-prefix cell 0b run 9b0d4994 (warm recall@500
0.4563981551, WO-4's CPU half of the mps/cpu pair). The only difference from that
Noise rule (owner, 2026-10-07): a single-seed difference under 0.03 absolute is not
a finding. If this lands within 0.03 of 0.4564, cell 0b runs at seeds 7, 13 and 21
on both trainers (item e); otherwise a position-mismatch design goes to the owner
first (item f), and is not run.
Projection, made before the run (see 'projection'): kill past 2x.

basis: Encoder: 27,940 back-to-back windows per pass at about 533 us each (WO-3 pilot 1
measured 45.1 s per pass for the BCE cell, matching the cost model), so about 15 s
per pass. Loss: the strict-prefix cell 0b spent about 0.024 s per step outside the
encoder (0.297 s per step solo, of which 512 encoder rows are about 0.273 s); the
sampled-softmax logits are one (512 x 64) @ (64 x 18,778) product per step whatever
the trainer, so about 0.024-0.04 s per step x 2,425 steps = 60-100 s per pass.
Per pass 75-115 s; 3-5 passes plus probe and holdout scoring each pass.
